    # Wait for the 'plain-html' template radio to be visible and click it (ninth in list, index 8)
    await page.get_by_role("radio", name="Use template").nth(8).wait_for(state="visible")

    # Fill in the project name as 'web_agent_index'

    await page.get_by_role("button", name="Create project").click()
